scope: Every copied regular file plus full outer uncompressed native payloads (including sparse .rec/.dat), source ZIP contents and complete unique JAR class contents. Inner native payloads are exactly SHA/mode/owner bound to scanned outer members. No private-key files, process environment or original PG payload collected; configured SSH key filepath strings are not key contents. Protected manifest contains hashes/metadata only. Known-marker review is finite, not a general secret-detection guarantee.
